Yes, it takes place during WWII, but this movie focuses on exploring the behaviors and attitudes of the "Old South" in relation to its own history and the War Between The States more than to what was going on in the outside world in WWII. If that's you and you also have interest in "Southern "Mint Julep" culture" or the Civil War... you'll flip for this one.

rv: I think that political correctness and its close cousin historical revisionism have done much to destroy our understanding of the world before and around us.
